Clear aligner orthodontic treatment

A discreet way to explore a straighter smile

If brackets and wires are not what you had in mind, you can start by discussing clear aligner care. The consultation sets realistic boundaries around what aligners may and may not address.

Invisalign uses a series of clear aligners planned around an individual case. The confirmed Phase 3 catalog includes Invisalign clear aligner care; the clinician determines the appropriate plan, sequence, and retention conversation.

Confirmed care paths

  • Invisalign clear aligner consultation
  • Treatment planning around individual goals and bite considerations
  • Retention and maintenance planning after active aligner care
  • Referral or another orthodontic path when appropriate
Practice context

Invisalign for teens and adults is identified in the verified public and local service catalogs. This page avoids claiming that every patient or alignment concern is suitable.

01

Who may be a candidate

Teens and adults interested in clear aligner care may request a consultation.

02

What an online page cannot decide

Not every alignment or bite concern can be addressed with the same aligner plan. Candidacy and scope require an examination and treatment planning; no result or duration is promised online.

Start with clarity

Your Winter Park consultation

  1. 01

    Discuss the changes you want and the daily routine you need treatment to fit.

  2. 02

    Review the teeth, bite, and relevant diagnostic or planning information.

  3. 03

    Talk through the confirmed plan, limitations, attachments or refinements if applicable, retention, maintenance, and next steps.

Before you decide

What to expect

The practice explains the expected sequence and follow-up for the individual plan. Timing varies by case and is not promised on this page; retention is part of the long-term conversation.

Clear aligners are removable, but any orthodontic care can require an adjustment period. Share concerns about comfort, speech, schedule, or anxiety during consultation so the plan can be discussed honestly.

Possible benefits

  • A discreet aligner-based option to discuss
  • A plan that can account for daily routine and smile goals
  • Early discussion of limitations, retention, and maintenance

Limitations & alternatives

  • Aligners are not appropriate for every case
  • Progress and timing depend on the individual plan and follow-through
  • Another orthodontic approach or referral may be recommended

After your visit

Care, recovery & maintenance

Follow the wear, cleaning, appointment, and retention instructions provided for your plan. The practice will explain any relevant care guide and how maintenance fits into the next phase.

Patient resourceReview pre- and post-operative careUse the guide as a supplement to the instructions provided by the practice.

Planning the investment

Insurance & financing questions

Insurance and financing for aligner care depend on the plan and lender. Ask the team for current information; no coverage, price, or approval is promised on this page.

Questions patients ask

Start with the questions that matter to you

Is Invisalign right for every patient?

No. The clinician needs to evaluate the teeth, bite, goals, and treatment scope before recommending aligners or another approach.

How long does Invisalign take?

Timing varies by case and plan. The practice explains the expected sequence during consultation rather than publishing a universal promise.

Are aligners the only option?

No. The consultation can compare clear aligners with another orthodontic approach or referral when that is more appropriate.

What happens after aligner treatment?

Retention and maintenance are part of the treatment conversation. The practice explains the plan and follow-up that apply to you.
